question: I was going through our previous conversation about high-end fashion brands, and I was wondering if you could remind me of the brand that uses wild rubber sourced from the Amazon rainforest?

gold_sessions.user_turns:
[turn 0] How does a high-end fashion brand differ from fast fashion?

[turn 2] That makes sense. I've always wondered why high-end fashion brands are so expensive.

[turn 4] I see, I never realized how much goes into creating high-end fashion pieces. Do you think investing in high-end brands is worth it?

[turn 6] I agree, it's important to consider my budget before investing in high-end brands. But I do love the idea of owning a piece that lasts a long time and has a unique design. Do you have any recommendations for high-end brands that prioritize sustainability?

[turn 8] I really like the idea of buying from brands that are committed to sustainability. I'll definitely check those out. Do you know if any of these brands have sales or discounts on their products?

[turn 10] I'll keep an eye out for sales and promotions, and I'll definitely look into shopping secondhand. Sustainability and quality are important to me, but I also want to be smart with my spending.
